## Summary

## Verification

## Checklist

- [ ] The Release build completes without warnings or errors.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and keyboard shortcuts are documented where needed.
- [ ] New dependencies are Microsoft-maintained or have been justified.
- [ ] The change does not commit generated `bin`, `obj`, or publish output.
- [ ] The pull request has an appropriate release-note label, or `skip-changelog`.
